description_en: Queries the tags bound to one or more PolarDB clusters, or the PolarDB clusters bound to one or more tags
description_zh: 查询一个或多个PolarDB集群已绑定的标签列表，或者查询一个或多个标签绑定的PolarDB集群列表
kebab_example: aliyun polardb list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to cluster
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义，取值固定为cluster
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The token used to return more results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. If the first query does not return all results, you can pass the token returned in the previous response to the next query to obtain more results
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，如果第一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target cluster. To query the tags of multiple clusters, click Add to add more cluster IDs.

You must specify at least one of the ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key parameters.
If you specify the ResourceId.N parameter, you can add up to 50 cluster IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh:
目标集群ID。若您需要查询多个集群的标签情况，请单击添加来添加目标集群ID。

`ResourceId.N`参数和`Tag.N.Key`参数至少传入一个。
若选择传入`ResourceId.N`参数，则每次最多添加50个集群ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. To query the details of all target clusters under multiple tags, click Add to add more tags.

You must specify at least one of the ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key parameters.
If you specify the Tag.N.Key parameter, you can add up to 20 tag key-value pairs at a time
fields.help_zh:
标签键。若您需要查询多个标签下的所有目标集群详情，请单击添加来添加标签。

`ResourceId.N`参数和`Tag.N.Key`参数至少传入一个。
若选择传入`Tag.N.Key`参数，则每次最多添加20对标签
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value corresponding to the tag key. An empty string is allowed
fields.help_zh: 标签键对应的标签值，允许传入空字符串
fields.name: value

NextToken.description_en: The token used to return more results. This parameter is returned if a single query does not return all results. You can pass the token returned in the previous response to the next query to obtain more results
NextToken.description_zh: 用来返回更多结果。如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则会返回该参数。您可以在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询
